chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Nuʿaym ibn Ibrāhīm, from ʿAbbād al-Baṣrī, who said:

I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about three men who testified against a man for zinā and said, “Now we will bring the fourth.” He said: “They are to be flogged with the hadd of the slanderer, eighty lashes, each one of them.”

key_terms.بِالرَّابِعِ: with the fourth witness required to complete testimony
key_terms.ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً: eighty lashes as the fixed legal penalty
key_terms.حَدَّ الْقَاذِفِ: the prescribed punishment for false accusation of zinā

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if only three witnesses testify to zinā and say they will bring a fourth later?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning an accusation of zinā made by only three witnesses. Since the required fourth witness was not yet present, each of the three is punished with the hadd of qadhf, which is eighty lashes. The report underscores the strict evidentiary standard in Islamic judicial rulings regarding zinā accusations.
